text:
sara: Quick sprint sync — prelaunch SEO ops for the webinar + benchmark post. Need a small checklist: redirects ownership, crawl-priority tagging, schema types to add, keyword mapping, and a simple internal-link plan. Who can own the redirect sweep?
emily: I can take redirects. Will do a patterns export from ga + GSC. Any hard rules?
mike: Can we prioritize pages with demo intent + sign-up CTAs? Those should be high-priority redirects if we're consolidating. Also flag pages with >2% conversion.
jordan: For schema: add Event + FAQ + Breadcrumbs on the webinar page. For benchmark blog: Article + Speakable if we clip audio. Also ensure canonical tags for republished content.
sara: @emily thanks — please put redirect candidates into the shared sheet and tag owner column. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample (placeholder)
emily: done — I added a `redirect_owner` column and a quick `notes` cell for why to redirect. Sample rows: ```/old-webinar -> /webinar-2026-04 (301) | owner: emily | reason: duplicate event page```
mike: Internal linking: add 3 contextual links from product pages to blog benchmark, and 2 CTAs back to webinar sign-up from the benchmark post. Use do-follow, natural anchors (no exact-match spam).
jordan: Crawl-priority tagging idea: add a `data-crawl-priority` meta tag for our CMS so crawler rules can be adjusted. Short term: maintain a sitemap with <priority> for webinar and benchmark posts.
seo-bot: [AUTO] Ran quick broken-link scan on staging, found 7 404s under /resources/* — pinged emily with details.
emily: saw bot report, fixing 3 now. Will include redirect mapping for the other 4 in the sheet.
sara: Timeline: redirects + sitemap updates by EOD Wed, schema rollout Thurs, content links merged Fri. Can everyone confirm?
mike: Confirmed. Will do the CTAs this week.
jordan: Confirmed for schema, will add JSON-LD snippets to the CMS template. Example snippet to drop in: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Product Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-10T16:00:00Z"}```
emily: Confirmed for redirects + owner tags. I'll assign PRs for the 301s.
sara: Perfect. After this, let's run a quick prelaunch crawl and capture baseline traffic for the benchmark narrative. I'll draft the recording brief. :+1:
emily: tagging the spreadsheet with `prelaunch-crawl` when ready.
